cases.name: custom-resource-template-placement
cases.prompt: My Plugin Framework provider lives in repo terraform-provider-acme and uses tfplugindocs via go generate. For the resource `acme_widget` I want the Registry page to start with a hand-written overview paragraph and a usage example, but still show the generated argument/attribute reference. Tell me exactly which files to create (full repo-relative paths and names), what the template must contain so the schema section still renders, and how the output ends up in the repo.
cases.trap: Agents (and the current skill) put the .md.tmpl under docs/, keep the provider prefix in the template file name, or write a template that drops the generated schema block.
expectations: Places the template at templates/resources/widget.md.tmpl (templates/ directory, no acme_ prefix in the file name)
Template includes the schema placeholder (e.g. {{ .SchemaMarkdown }}) so the generated argument/attribute section still renders
Places the example at examples/resources/acme_widget/resource.tf (prefix kept for example directories) and pulls it into the template (e.g. via tffile/.HasExample) or relies on the default rendering
States the rendered output is docs/resources/widget.md produced by tfplugindocs generate and should not be hand-edited
negative_expectations: Copies the argument reference by hand into the template instead of using the generated schema

cases.name: list-resource-example-file
cases.prompt: Our provider now implements a list resource `acme_server` for terraform query. tfplugindocs generates docs/list-resources/server.md but the page has no example. Where exactly does the example file go and what must it be named?
cases.trap: List resource examples use the .tfquery.hcl extension, not .tf; agents default to resource.tf or list-resource.tf.
expectations: Explains the .tfquery.hcl extension is required for list resource examples
Says to rerun tfplugindocs generate afterwards
negative_expectations: Names the example list-resource.tf or resource.tf
Edits docs/list-resources/server.md by hand to add the example
